_readme: Three inputs Jon supplied, named per-pose directives restored (the one element every held-pose run has had), Jon's change clause plus an explicit bare-hips sentence for the leftover-bottoms problem.
Paired with its with-refs twin: identical but for the reference images, to settle whether the clothed refs are what leaves clothing on the output.

cfg 2.0: at cfg 1.0 ComfyUI skips the negative pass entirely, so every negative in this project has been inert. Above 1.0 it applies, which is why a clothing negative appears here and nowhere earlier. Raising cfg forces lora_strength 0 (build_refs.sampler_settings), hence mode quality for the step count.

env._RENDER_ATTEMPTS: Backends 0 and 1 ONLY. Verified 2026-08-15 by reading /object_info off each box: cerberus and gamingpc both hold qwen_image_edit_2511_fp8mixed + the 2511 Lightning 4-step LoRA, same filenames. peaches (backend 2) holds NEITHER and can only refuse these workflows; ethan (3) is unreachable. pipeline._attempt_plan walks running backends in id order, so capping the attempts at 2 stops the walk before it ever reaches peaches.
